title: commit_group rsp
description: Response to cmd:commit_group. Describes what cmd_commit_group_ (backend/src/service_cmd_dispatch.cpp) ACTUALLY emits: data carries `status` ("committed" = all targets committed / "partial" = at least one faulted) plus a `results` array, one entry per target with its name, per-target ok, and the committed def echo (an {"error"} object on a per-target fault). The envelope `ok` mirrors `status`: committed => ok:true, partial => ok:false with an `error` string (a partial commit halts dispatch — config-fault latched). The `status==partial => ok==false` pairing cannot be expressed in the constrained subset (no if/then); it is guarded by a consumer test (tools/xinsp2_py/tests/test_run_outcome.py).
